images.note: Expects a FOLDER PATH on the ComfyUI host containing the character's reference images (videos/audio also accepted), not a single file. Widget 1 'use_subfolders', widget 2 'use_folder_as_name'.

character.note: The node itself writes the RefMod file when widget 25 'save' is true; the RefMod name is widget 3 'name' (default 'name_refMod'), optional subfolder widget 26.

notes: No prompt, seed or batch: this is a one-shot extraction. Widget 4 'extraction_preset' (identity_encode), widget 5 'concept_type' (identity), widget 7 'mode' (Full Reference).
The runner must set widget 3 'name' per character so RefMods do not overwrite each other.
Rights: build RefMods only from references the client owns (docs/H3-REFMODS.md).
